text:
Type: yellow cube shelving unit
Use: storing books, toys and storage boxes, room divider; living room, children's room, home office
Style: contemporary, modern, retro
Materials: painted board with a smooth bright finish
Colors: sunny yellow
Shape: upright rectangular frame with eight square open cubes in two columns, thick flat panels, open back, chunky and boxy, works upright or on its side
Feel: cheerful, bold, playful, energetic
Goes with: white or grey walls, light wood, grey textiles, black accents; modern, retro or kids' rooms

product.name: KALLAX
product.description: Choose whether you want to place it vertically or horizontally and use it as a shelf or sideboard.
